name: Freelance transcriptionist (short audio clips)
summary: Transcribe short audio clips on TranscribeMe's WorkHub platform after passing an entrance exam, paid per audio hour via PayPal.
whatYouDo: After passing an entrance exam, you log into WorkHub and transcribe short audio clips (described as 2–4 minutes) following TranscribeMe's style guide. With experience and extra exams you can join specialty teams (e.g. legal, medical) that pay more.
appeal: Short clips suit small blocks of free time
No experience needed to start; mainly a computer and internet connection
Specialty teams (legal, medical) pay more after additional exams
Paid through PayPal, which operates in Canada
watchOuts: Low starting pay: $15–22 per audio hour, and one audio hour can take several hours to transcribe
Unpaid entrance exam (style-guide quiz plus short audio clips)
Canada eligibility only evidenced by a third-party 'worldwide' listing, not an official country list
Several sources found are more than two years old; rates and exam availability may have changed

training.notes: Must learn the style guide for the entrance exam; no paid training identified.

compensation.notes: Official freelancer page (per search summary) cites starting rates of $15–22 per audio hour, converted here to roughly $0.25–0.37 per audio minute. Specialty-team rates cited variously as ~$36–40 or $60–70+ per audio hour. Currency not stated in indexed text (US company; likely USD).

reliability.notes: No official or independent evidence on task supply was found in this pass.

applicationSteps: Sign up on TranscribeMe's WorkHub site
Pass the general entrance exam (style-guide quiz plus short audio clips)
Account is activated after a pass; start transcribing short clips
Optionally take further exams to join specialty teams
fitsIf: You want a low-commitment, text-only side task you can do in 10–20 minute bursts and are comfortable with modest pay while you build speed.
notFitIf: You need at least minimum-wage-equivalent hourly earnings from the start.
